2) Please also share your **order id** (format like **#W0000000**).

Once I can look up the order, I’ll check:
- whether it’s **pending** (so I can change the delivery address) or **delivered** (so I can do the exchange), and
- the Bluetooth Speaker options available—then I can propose the **cheapest green** version to exchange.
